governingRules.appliesTo: All newly scheduled and remaining future posts for Bizarre Past YouTube and TikTok, Little Wild Adventures YouTube, and What If in 40 Seconds YouTube; Shorts and long-form.
governingRules.checkBeforeScheduling: Read actual queue first. Check unique video ID and correct target channel, reject duplicates.
mandatoryQC: Full-motion scenes with no Ken Burns slideshow
Title, metadata, hashtags and thumbnail appropriate
governingRules.truth: Status produced, scheduled, published or failed must originate from a verified platform response.
governingRules.apiLimit: AI Tuber Autopilot recurring settings cannot currently be read/changed with connected public API; manual confirmation required.
governingRules.qualityVsVolume: Many strong videos with production buffer; no weak releases to meet a quota.
governingRules.governingPlan: Latest explicit 02.11.2026 agreement: Mon/Wed/Fri Shorts 35–40 sec; Sun 16:9 feature 8–10 min; publish all 18:00 Europe/Oslo; quality and actual verified bookings take priority. Older conflicting schedules obsolete.
governingRules.publishTimePrecision: All newly produced or rescheduled videos target 18:00 Europe/Oslo. Existing six Bizarre Past publications are already verified at 18:00.

afterExistingQueue.priority: Quality and engagement are mandatory while keeping a strong publishing volume; the goal is organic views, subscribers and eventual monetization.
afterExistingQueue.opening: Start EVERY new Bizarre Past film with a clear spoken and visually legible 'Did you know…' within the first two seconds; get straight to the surprising claim/question.
afterExistingQueue.storytelling: One intriguing historically grounded premise, immediate visual action, escalation, reveals and a compelling, complete payoff, no meandering or abrupt end.
requiredBeforeScheduling: Independent fact checking with reputable historical/archaeological sources; clearly distinguish documented evidence, legend and religious interpretation
Real full-motion cinematic Higgsfield sequences; scenes must match the exact narrator lines
Previously approved engaging narration (avoid rejected deeper voice), balanced suspenseful music, crisp captions, smooth cuts and 1080p
Review full MP4 including spoken and visual first two seconds, mid-video pacing, all historical claims and final sentence; rework weak film
Strong accurate searchable title and thumbnail (especially for long-form), description, useful hashtags and proper AI/synthetic disclosure
Confirm correct channel(s), single publication per destination, no duplicate upload and 18:00 Europe/Oslo booked time

monitorAfterRelease.rule: Compare equivalent formats and publication age, isolate what works, improve the next script based on evidence rather than copying trends blindly.

afterExistingQueue.productionFlow: Research → hook/script → storyboard/Higgsfield scenes → sound/edit → full playback QC → verify queue → book for 18:00 Metricool → check platform status → learn from performance.
afterExistingQueue.unchangedQueue: Do not replace or overwrite the 3 existing unique topics (Oak Island, Knights Templar, Pastry War), each with YouTube + TikTok planned releases 4/6/8 Nov at 18:00.
afterExistingQueue.dontPromiseRevenue: Monetization depends on eligibility, originality, audience response and platform review; no guaranteed earnings.
